source.citation: Project owner, Glessner House version 4 reconstruction brief, 29 September 2026: correct intersecting roofs, courtyard and garden-level openings, continuous copper roof at the inner northeast corner, variable-height ashlar courses, and east-wing chimneys. Follow-up 1 October 2026: rebuild west-wing roof, gables and dormer from northwest/west views; carve the north entrance alcove with left-turn steps and door against HABS floor plans.
what_it_does_not_supply: A measured survey or a dated 1904 view.
Reusable photographic textures or permission to redistribute third-party reference images.
Exact dimensions, colour, roof patina, plantings, or a pre-1946 date for an otherwise undocumented opening.
what_it_supplies: The owner-requested visible omissions to correct in version 4.
Qualitative cross-check that a cross gable, west-wing courtyard windows, garden-level lights and a continuous corner copper roof should not be omitted.
T-1830 owner request and qualitative roof/entrance comparisons; first- and second-floor HABS plans supply dimensional control.
